note: KRX non-trading weekdays. Weekends are handled in code and are not listed here. KIS's own holiday API (CTCA0903R) is rejected on paper accounts ('모의투자 TR 이 아닙니다'), so this file is the substitute while paper trading; switch to that API once running on a live account.
verification: Dates up to verified_through were derived from actual KIS daily bars (005930): every weekday with no bar is a closure. Later dates are projected from the public holiday calendar and MUST be confirmed against KRX's official schedule before they arrive. 2026-09-28 was listed as a Chuseok substitute holiday and removed on 2026-09-25: the substitute rule for Seollal and Chuseok applies only when the holiday period overlaps a Sunday or another public holiday, and the 2026 period (Thu 09-24 to Sat 09-26) overlaps neither, so KRX trades that Monday. Projections are a guess until a bar confirms them; this one was wrong in the direction that silently skips a trading day.
fail_open: A date missing from this list is treated as a trading day. Being wrong that way only wastes a poll — KIS simply returns no bars — whereas wrongly skipping a real trading day would silently stop trading.
